description: This file defines a React functional component named MemberDashboard, which renders a user interface dashboard for gym members. The dashboard displays information such as the next workout session, current membership details, progress snapshot link, and upcoming schedule items. It fetches data from various API endpoints and manages state accordingly.

methods.name: MemberDashboard()
methods.description: React component rendering the member's dashboard with upcoming sessions, membership info, and progress links.

methods.name: loadSchedule
methods.description: Asynchronously loads schedule data either from the API endpoint or by fallback mapping sessions.
